subject.title: Feishu: @mention not recognized in group when multiple bots share the same group (open_id app-scoped mismatch)

question: Which Feishu bot identity source should become canonical for group @mention admission when event open_id values are app-scoped?
rationale: The source-level failure is clear, but choosing union_id, app_id/cross-app open_id collection, another Feishu identity field, or a documented limitation affects message suppression and misrouting in shared groups.

options.title: Prove and land stable identity matching
options.body: Rework the linked PR on current main around a verified Feishu identity source, then cover parser, post, command, debounce, and live multi-bot behavior.

options.title: Document the limitation
options.body: If Feishu does not expose a reliable cross-app bot identity, keep requireMention conservative and document the supported multi-bot workaround.

options.title: Fold into broader Feishu routing design
options.body: Treat this as part of a larger Feishu multi-bot identity/session design with the broader open Feishu identity issue.

recommendation.title: Prove and land stable identity matching
recommendation.body: Rework the linked PR on current main around a verified Feishu identity source, then cover parser, post, command, debounce, and live multi-bot behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They are already assigned to the linked PR and requested a current-main rewrite on the exact Feishu identity decision surface.
